name: Helicopter Flight from the Palm Island
summary: Exploring Dubai through its iconic sights is a captivating experience, yet navigating the bustling city streets during peak hours can pose challenges. However, opting for a helicopter tour offers an uninterrupted and awe-inspiring view of the cityscape. Flying over Dubai unveils a panoramic perspective, allowing close-up glimpses of renowned landmarks like the Burj Khalifa, Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah, Atlantis the Palm Hotel, The World Islands, and Jumeirah Mosque.

restrictions: pregnancy policy: should the passenger be 7 months pregnant or more, a valid doctor's certificate must be provided stating that she is medically tit and able to fly
notes: should carry original passport or id
Sharing: The weight limit is 110kgs per passenger per seat
Private: The maximum total weight limit is 450kgs per flight as per the weight and balance limitation of the aircraft
Prohibited Items: Hazardous materials, explosives, weapons, flammable liquids, foods and beverages are prohibited on our helicopter flights
Guests with Disability: We are happy to accept the booking, provided the passenger is accompanied by a companion who is able to assist with boarding and deboarding during the flight
We are located at the Dubai: Atlantis Hotel helipad on The Palm Jumeirah see us on Google Maps(https://maps.app.goo.gl/cKY9xx89KzwcsmNe8)
